page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, configured with 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. The processor includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES-NI, though newer instructions such as AMX and SHA-NI are absent. Memory provisioning stands at 128.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not feature bundled local storage or integrated hardware GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and standard network egress capped at a 10 Gbps baseline.

Benchmark outcomes show a clear distinction between the system's single-core and multi-core throughput. Single-core tests reveal modest compute capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 995.0, a stress-ng single-core rating of 1107.99, and single-threaded gzip compression achieving 19.22 GB/sec, placing it in the lower quartile of tested systems. Conversely, its multi-threaded capabilities leverage all 32 vCPUs effectively, registering average-tier performance across stress-ng multi-core (23637.07), PassMark CPU (23223.67), and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (108.79 GB/sec). Memory throughput reaches 96.24 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 48.07 GB/sec for writes.

From an architectural tradeoff perspective, the ecs.g5.8xlarge delivers balanced memory capacity and stable multi-core throughput, but is constrained by single-thread compute latency and the lack of local NVMe storage. Because storage operations depend entirely on network-attached volumes, overall I/O performance will hinge on external disk allocations. In workload execution, the server demonstrates solid mid-tier capabilities for concurrent tasks, achieving 22.63 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, 17.15 GB/sec static web serving throughput, and steady Clang compilation throughput (18474.0). It is well matched for horizontally scalable enterprise applications, distributed caching layers, web serving tiers, and multi-threaded background processing services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, it maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, complemented by a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance includes no bundled local storage and zero hardware GPUs. Across benchmarks, the server demonstrates average multi-core and memory performance, scoring 23,223.67 in PassMark CPU and completing 22.63 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-core compute results remain in the lower quartile with a Geekbench single-core score of 995.0. Lacking local disks, storage requires network-attached volumes. The instance is suited for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, web serving, distributed caching, and backend batch processing.
